notes: OFFSET — A monochrome design engineering journal with four interactive generative figures: (1) force-directed whitespace layout with draggable blocks, (2) phi phenomenon motion demonstrations exploiting perceptual persistence, (3) reactive design token engine with live primitive sliders, (4) real-time luminance structure analysis of the page itself. All figures render to canvas via vanilla JS (~45KB total). No external dependencies, no build step, respects prefers-reduced-motion, WCAG 2.1 AA accessible, works offline and on GitHub Pages. Known limitation: constraint figure requires scroll position to analyze live page structure; initial render may be empty until scroll occurs.
